title: mallard check --restart FILE --format json: the restart member
description: The restart member of mallard check's JSON report (schema mallard-check): null without a start from a restart file, else the file and what a start from it does with each key the case changes from the input it was written with. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

file.description: The restart file, as the input or --restart names it.

t.description: Its simulated time, in the input's units.

run_id.description: The run that wrote it; null if its run block does not say.

input_recorded.description: Its run block holds the resolved input it was written with; without it, changes lists no keys of the input.

changes.description: One per key that differs between the file's resolved input and the case's ([initialize] left out), and for a dimension, precision or variables the build or case does not share with the file.

key.description: The key, its entries by name where they have one: boundaries[name = "inlet"].type; or build.dimension, build.precision, variables.

restart.description: Its value in the file's input, as TOML; null where not set.

case.description: Its value in the case's resolved input, as TOML; null where not set.

effect.description: accepted: the run continues the file's state; resets: some state of the file starts afresh (W-RESTART-RESETS); incompatible: the file cannot be continued (E-RESTART-INCOMPATIBLE).

detail.description: What starts afresh, or why the file cannot be continued; for accepted, a note or null.
